description:
High-level OPC UA Client and Server SDK for Java.
        Provides symbolic read/write, subscriptions, alarms, historical
        access, and method calls over OPC UA TCP and HTTPS.
        Evaluation mode: pass two empty strings for user name and serial number and the
        library runs for 15 minutes during a debug session - enough to bring up a
        connection and read values. For uninterrupted work, generate a free trial
        license (14 days): https://www.indi-an.com/en/plccom/opc-ua-sdk/opcua-download/
